frames.observation: Creation form, member row and project controls occupy the scrollable left pane without overlap with Tasks.
Launch modal stays inside the viewport; project picker, optional settings and checking state remain distinct. Screenshot captures checking, not a launched provider.
Dark theme preserves aligned creation controls and readable section labels; lower settings continue below the viewport in the scrollable pane.
Light theme preserves the same control alignment and section hierarchy. Several controls are disabled in this captured state.
At 1024x720, the header actions stack and controls remain inside the left pane. The long template placeholder is visibly cropped before the end of its final word beside the chevron.
Traditional Chinese glyphs, strict-allowlist mode, scope checkboxes and github,sentry input render legibly; explanatory note wraps within its panel.
At 1280x900, the stacked template action shows the complete label. This is a wider viewport than Windows, so it is not an equal-size OS comparison.
Traditional Chinese labels and allowlist controls render legibly; source-scope controls and explanatory note remain within their panel.

findings.description: The long template-placeholder label is cropped next to its chevron. The control remains visible and original scenario succeeds. A wider Ubuntu1280x900 frame fits the whole label. No equal-viewport baseline or newly introduced regression is established.
sourceFacts: TeamTemplatePicker uses the full Team template aria-label.
The unchanged shared SelectTrigger combines whitespace-nowrap with child line-clamp-1.

limits: Only the 8 explicitly listed frames were visually inspected; no all-screenshot or complete visual qualification.
Static images do not independently prove interaction behavior; original job logs and artifact JSON carry functional results.
This review used cached ZIP/JSON/PNG data only; no browser, Electron, vendor/native child or test was launched by reviewer.
